title: First Contact
description: Select a particle, then a neighboring tile. Bring black and white together.

title: Closer
description: Move one tile at a time. Choose which particle takes the next step.

title: Four Corners
description: Matching colors block each other. Opposite colors remove the tile where they meet.

title: Leave a Path
description: The center is a tempting meeting place. A lost path will not return.

title: Passing By
description: Leave room for the other particle before bringing them together.

title: Narrow Bridge
description: The bridge is narrow. Choose where to meet before taking another step.

title: Fold
description: The two A tiles are linked. A portal move costs one step.

title: Across the Void
description: An opposite color at the exit merges on arrival. The entrance becomes a normal tile.

title: Echo
description: A portal can be a shortcut, or the place of a final meeting.

title: Double Fold
description: A links to A, and B links to B. Follow the matching letters.

title: In Due Order
description: Three pairs, limited paths. The order of collisions is part of the solution.

title: Negative Space
description: Bring every particle to rest, leaving only empty space.

title: Two Paths
description: Choose which stretch of path to preserve, then decide who moves closer.
concept: Regional pairing

title: Three Encounters
description: Three pairs share a narrow passage. Keep a route open for the last pair.
concept: Shared paths and collision order

title: Make Room
description: When matching colors block the way, make room for one another.
concept: Making room for matching colors

title: Across the Bridge
description: Not every tile is a good place to say goodbye.
concept: Preserving the only connection

title: Clear the Passage
description: A particle is waiting at the far end. Clear the exit before the next portal move.
concept: Clearing exits and protecting crossings

title: One Gate Left
description: Remove one portal, then cross the normal tile left at its partner.
concept: Routes after portal collapse

title: Crossed Signals
description: Two portal pairs connect separate paths. Bring the right colors together.
concept: Routing between regions

title: Clear the Exit
description: Sometimes the particle at the destination must move before a journey can begin.
concept: Blocked exits and detours

title: Counterflow
description: Three pairs share a narrow loop. Leave room for the last journey.
concept: Circulation and matching order

title: Step Back
description: The nearest meeting may be too soon.
concept: Retreating before a collision

title: Unravel
description: Every collision changes which paths remain. Untangle the queues before they close.
concept: Four-pair scheduling around a disappearing loop

title: Keep It Open
description: Some crossings must wait for another arrival.
concept: Repeated return traffic before closing a portal

title: Three Orbits
description: Three linked routes meet at a center that can change.
concept: Routing through three adjacent portal groups

title: Singularity
description: Four pairs, three gates, and very little room to say goodbye.
concept: A crowded three-gate network whose center must become ordinary floor

title: Interchange
description: Four linked routes share one narrow passage.
concept: Dense portal routing and exit scheduling

title: Cross Traffic
description: Occupied exits and six gates leave little room for a wrong turn.
concept: Dense portal routing and exit scheduling

title: Deep Field
description: The two distant ends can change the center of the network.
concept: Dense portal routing and exit scheduling

title: Supercluster
description: Twelve particles share six gates. Keep the whole network in mind.
concept: Dense portal routing and exit scheduling

title: Slipstream
description: A particle may rest on an arrow, but can leave only along it.
concept: A particle may rest on an arrow, but can leave only along it.

title: Circulation
description: Choose the two meeting points before the orbit breaks.
concept: Choose the two meeting points before the orbit breaks.

title: Deflection
description: The shortest route follows the current; a longer way remains.
concept: The shortest route follows the current; a longer way remains.

title: Catch Basin
description: A field with no exit can still be the right place to meet.
concept: A field with no exit can still be the right place to meet.

title: Turnstile
description: One-way traffic changes how the three gates share their exits.
concept: One-way traffic changes how the three gates share their exits.

title: Point of No Return
description: Four pairs need room to pass the current before the last gate closes.
concept: Four pairs need room to pass the current before the last gate closes.
